As a freshman at Xavier, Christon established himself as one of the top players in the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]], averaging 15.2 [[points per game|points]] and 4.6 [[assists per game]], earning Atlantic 10 Rookie of the Year honors.{{cite web | last = Eisenberg| first = Jeff | title = Point guard Semaj Christon aims to lead retooled Xavier back to prominence | work = [[Yahoo! Sports]] | date = October 23, 2013 | url = http://sports.yahoo.com/blogs/ncaab-the-dagger/point-guard-semaj-christon-aims-lead-retooled-xavier-202851112--ncaab.html | accessdate = May 14, 2014}} As a sophomore, Christon improved in several areas as he led the Musketeers into the [[Big East Conference]]. After averaging 17 points and 4.2 assists, he was unanimously named first team All-Big East in 2014.{{cite web | last = Russell| first = Shannon | title = Semaj Christon unanimous Big East first team pick | work = [[Cincinnati Enquirer]] | date = March 9, 2014 | url = http://www.cincinnati.com/story/blogs/2014/03/09/semaj-christon-big-east-first-team/6231793/ | accessdate = May 14, 2014}} ==Professional career== On March 28, 2014, Christon declared his eligibility for the [[2014 NBA draft]], bypassing his final two seasons at Xavier.{{cite web | last = Giles| first = Matt | title = Xavier’s Semaj Christon bypasses final two years, declares for the 2014 draft | work = [[NBCSports.com]] | date = March 28, 2014| url = http://collegebasketballtalk.nbcsports.com/2014/03/28/xaviers-semaj-christon-forgoes-eligibility-declares-for-the-2014-draft/ | accessdate = May 14, 2014}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.goxavier.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/semaj_christon_799087.html Xavier bio] {{Persondata | NAME = Christon, Semaj | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = November 1, 1992 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Cincinnati, Ohio]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Christon, Semaj}} [[Category:1992 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Ohio]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Cincinnati, Ohio]] [[Category:Xavier Musketeers men's basketball players]]
